Amazing Food. All are MSG-free
Feb 2017 • Friends
This restaurant serves Vietnamese dishes at very reasonable prices. We had a chance to spoke with the owner, Vi Nguyen, and we were glad to know that all of their dishes are monosodium glutamate (MSG) free which is really amazing. We're able to eat all of the dishes on our table without feeling dizzy afterward. The food presentation was amazing. They also have different fish sauces which are very tasty and perfect complement to each of the dishes served. I love all the food we ordered but my favorite is the stir fried tofu with lemongrass strips. Tasted so good!

This is definitely a must-visit restaurant when you're in Ho Chi Minh City!!!

An excellent lunch, authentic Vietnamese cuisine.
Nov 2016 • Friends
Tried loads of dishes at this restaurant. Superbly tasty and well marinated dishes. The owner was really nice and actually explained how each dish is prepared and we totally love the presentation. The secret we found out was the special fish sauce used in the marinates n sauces. The fish sauce is actually homemade by the owner's mother! Secret number 2, the fresh water fish used in making the special fish sauce hails from .. u guessed it.. their family's fish farm. Talk about QC control indeed! 

Try the beef skewers! And everything else on their menu haha. 

Had their Vietnamese coffee after lunch. Watching the world go by while watching the coffee drip. 

*burps
